title: Self-defence and de-escalation
learning_outcomes: Explain environmental awareness in the context of self-defence and de-escalation.
Compare and distinguish verbal de-escalation in the context of self-defence and de-escalation.
Apply escape and assistance in the context of self-defence and de-escalation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about legal boundaries in the context of self-defence and de-escalation.

lessons.title: Environmental awareness
lessons.outcome: Explain environmental awareness in the context of self-defence and de-escalation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving environmental awareness; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to non-contact scenario plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain environmental awareness from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of environmental awareness; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Verbal de-escalation
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish verbal de-escalation in the context of self-defence and de-escalation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving verbal de-escalation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to non-contact scenario plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain verbal de-escalation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of verbal de-escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Escape and assistance
lessons.outcome: Apply escape and assistance in the context of self-defence and de-escalation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving escape and assistance; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to non-contact scenario plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain escape and assistance from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of escape and assistance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Legal boundaries
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about legal boundaries in the context of self-defence and de-escalation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving legal boundaries; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to non-contact scenario plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain legal boundaries from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of legal boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of environmental awareness; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of verbal de-escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of escape and assistance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of legal boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
